kjv: the light shall not be clear, nor dark
mine: there will be no light; the glorious lights will congeal
note: An obscure line: lo'-yihyeh 'or yeqarot yiqpa'un (ketiv) / weqippa'on (qere); yeqarot "precious, glorious ones" is probably the luminaries and qp' means "congeal, freeze" (many emend to "no cold or frost"). The KJV took the words as "clear" and "dark".

kjv: there shall be no more the Canaanite
mine: there will no longer be a trader
note: Hebrew kena'ani can be the ethnic term or the common noun "trader, merchant" (as in Prov 31:24; Zeph 1:11); in a verse about Temple vessels and sacrifices the commercial sense fits well.
